# planetscale_neki_router (Resource)

NekiRouter Resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Branch name from `list_branches`. Example: `main`. Requires replacement if changed.
- `database` (String) Database name slug from `list_databases`. Example: `app-db`. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) The name of the router group. Letters, digits, dashes, and underscores; 1-64 characters; cannot start or end with a dash or underscore. `new`, `primary`, and `replica` are reserved. Clients connect through the group by appending it to the username, e.g. `user|my-router`. Requires replacement if changed.
- `organization` (String) Organization name slug from `list_organizations`. Example: `acme`. Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `autoscaling` (Boolean) Whether the router scales horizontally within each cell
- `max_replicas_per_cell` (Number) The maximum number of replicas in each cell when autoscaling
- `replicas_per_cell` (Number) The new number of replicas in each cell
- `router_size` (String) The new router size for the router
- `target_cpu_utilization` (Number) The target average CPU utilization percentage when autoscaling

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default router
- `id` (String) The ID of the router
- `state` (String) The current state of the router

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = planetscale_neki_router.my_planetscale_neki_router
  id = jsonencode({
    branch       = "..."
    database     = "..."
    name         = "..."
    organization = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import planetscale_neki_router.my_planetscale_neki_router '{"branch": "...", "database": "...", "name": "...", "organization": "..."}'
```
